justification: The only shared depicted content is the human figure, rendered in utterly different ways: A shows large, naturalistically modelled bearded figures in profile with elaborate garments, hair, weapons and ritual attributes facing one another, while B shows tiny stick-like schematic humans among crewed boats with rows of stroke-marks and abstract grid/ladder signs scattered over the surface. There is no correspondence in the specific motifs (boats, crew strokes vs. winged genii and staffs), in the relationships between figures, or in the composition, which is a single ordered register in A versus loosely scattered small signs in B.
